methods.label: Simplify and classify
methods.explanation: \(-\sqrt{9}=-3\), so \(-2\), \(0\), \(1/2\), and \(-3\) are rational, while \(\sqrt{3}\) and \(\pi\) are irrational. There are \(4\) rational numbers in total.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 real-number classification and evaluates a principal square root before applying its external minus sign.
